Strategy: Apply the sweet-band reward between thirty and forty-five only for items smaller than thirty, keeping the mid penalty always on. Small items can use middle residuals flexibly, but the gate may rarely engage and the threshold is a guess.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if item < 30 and r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
